title: [rereview] project-LICHEN-d7ub.71: lichen_sha256(NULL,0) test incompatible with strict NULL rejection
description:
Commit 3fb8e3815 changes lichen_sha256 to reject NULL input unconditionally (input == NULL -> -EINVAL), but the existing test at lichen/tests/util/main.c:29 calls lichen_sha256(NULL, 0, output) and expects 0 (success). This test will fail under the new contract.

Fix options:
1. Update the test to call with valid pointer + inlen=0 instead of NULL+0: 
2. Or update the test to expect -EINVAL (if the new behavior is intentional)

Also: the  block is dead code when input is NULL (already rejected) and unnecessary when input is non-NULL (tc_sha256_update ignores data pointer when data_length==0). Consider removing it for clarity.
